cards.card_text: And James adds one more word for it: demonic.
cards.verse_text: Such wisdom does not come from above, but is earthly, unspiritual, demonic.
cards.snippet: Such wisdom does not come from above, but is earthly, unspiritual, demonic.

cards.card_text: These demonic spirits perform signs and go out to all the kings of the earth.
cards.verse_text: These are demonic spirits that perform signs and go out to all the kings of the earth, to assemble them for battle on the great day of God the Almighty.
